newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: IBM, Serbia discuss equipment buy - agency.
newsitem.headline: IBM, Serbia discuss equipment buy - agency.

text.p: Serbian government officials discussed with International Business Machines Corp representatives the purchase of computer equipment for the republic's judicial bodies on Tuesday, Tanjug news agency reported.

The purchase would be part of a programme to introduce the most modern computer technology for 560 courts, prosecutors' and magistrates' offices and other judicial bodies, the report quoted a Serbian information ministry statement as saying.

Serbian Minister Coordinator Dragan Tomic, justice minister Arandjel Markicevic and minister Milun Babic participated in the negotiations with IBM vice-president for central Europe and Russia Dietrich Roessner and general manager for Yugoslavia Michael Strang.
